about: Match music round 1 (2026-10-17): ACE-Step 1.5 XL, local. One entry per prompt; `takes` seeds each. The operator: green = forest, animal sounds; white = uplifting adventure, taverns, trumpets; red = battle, intense, faster, visceral; blue = ethereal, water, mysterious; black = all three of gothic court, noir bargain, crypt and decay. Keep the variance between colours HIGH: each colour owns its instrument family, tempo band, mode and production, and only one or two prompts per colour are chiptune. `bed` layers a Stable Audio Open ambience under the take as a second, separately named candidate. Pairs come in a later spec.
